magpie Gateway Admin

Multi-user management for the magpie gateway: batch key issuance, limits, model permissions, and a usage dashboard. Members check their own usage on magpie's built-in /me page—nothing extra to deploy.

简体中文 · English

magpie's built-in Gateway page is designed for a single user: one shared key that cannot be renamed or disabled. This plugin covers the other part—opening the gateway to a group of people, with per-key permissions, limits, and usage. > [!NOTE] > The plugin does not replace magpie's Gateway page. The default shared key is still managed by magpie itself; this plugin manages the additional multi-user keys. ## Quick Start 1. Install the plugin: ```bash # From npm magpie plugin add magpie-gateway-admin # From GitHub (no npm needed; uses the build output committed in the repo) magpie plugin add github:guangzan/magpie-gateway-admin # From a local directory magpie plugin add /path/to/magpie-gateway-admin ``` 2. Open **Gateway Admin** in the sidebar. 3. Click **Batch issue keys**, set a name prefix, expiry, and permissions, then copy or export the plaintext keys. 4. To let users check their own usage, send them the gateway's **`/me` page**: `http://:3425/me` (use your gateway's actual port). Entering their key shows limits, usage, and client setup. See **Member Self-Service** below. magpie's **Gateway → Gateway keys** page has a Copy button for this address. The first open starts the plugin's local service at `http://127.0.0.1:3478/` (loopback only, for the admin). ## What It Does ### Users and Keys - **Batch issuance**: issue 1–100 keys at once, numbered from a prefix (`team-a-01`, `team-a-02`, …). The whole batch is transactional: if any key fails, every key already written in the batch is removed—no half-created keys without limits. - **Permissions**: the create form groups model allowlists (`openai/*`, `anthropic/claude-*`, `group/`, `group/*`), upstream accounts, limits, read-only mode, permission to read upstream account balances, and permission to issue child keys. - **Limits**: daily, weekly, monthly, every N days, or every N hours; up to five limits per key. Limits can count tokens or USD, and can include cache reads in the token count. Setting both tokens and USD to 0 means the limit is disabled. The form starts with one monthly $20 limit, which can be edited or removed. - **Limit scope**: magpie limits are not scoped per model (`access.Limit` has no such field), so the plugin does not expose a fake "only these models" switch. A limit applies to every call made with that key. - **Expiry and windows**: single-key creation accepts an exact expiry date; batch creation uses a number of valid days. When editing an existing key, the window start (`since`) and cache-read flag are preserved—changing a limit does not reset the current window. - **Secret delivery**: after creation, a delivery dialog offers per-key copy, copy all, and CSV export. The list itself only shows masked keys; rotation shows the new secret once more. - **Limit status**: each row shows the tightest active limit as used / limit / reset time. Exhausted limits are red. The detail view can zero out used amounts without changing the end of a calendar window. - **Usage columns**: each key shows calls and estimated cost for today, the last 7 days, or the last 30 days. Unpriced calls are marked with `*` and a count. - **Needs attention**: exhausted limits, limits at or above 80%, and keys expiring within 7 days appear as one-click filters. Keys can also be filtered by state and sorted by name, calls, cost, or limit usage. - **Bulk actions**: select multiple keys to enable, disable, or delete them. Confirmation dialogs list the affected key names. - **Search and pagination**: search by name, id, or masked key; pagination is local, so large key sets do not require endless scrolling. - **CSV export**: includes usage and is generated server-side under `plugin-data/magpie-gateway-admin/exports/` in the config directory. Filenames include a timestamp. If usage cannot be fetched, export fails instead of producing a fake "0 calls / $0" report. Deleted keys with recorded traffic are kept as "deleted" rows so their cost is not lost. ### Usage - Period summaries include total calls, errors, tokens, cache reads/writes, estimated cost, and unpriced calls. - Usage is grouped by key. Columns can be sorted by calls, errors, input, output, cache reads, or cost. Click a group to filter recent requests to that key; clear the filter with the × on the tag. - A request shows time, model, status, latency, input/output tokens, and cost. Requests can be filtered to failed or retried calls and searched. - If the gateway is unreachable or an endpoint fails, the page keeps a visible error and a **Retry** action instead of rendering zeros and empty tables. Changing the period clears stale numbers first so two periods cannot be mixed together. > [!NOTE] > Cost is estimated from gateway pricing. Unpriced calls count as $0 and do not consume USD limits. Periods follow the timezone of the machine running the gateway. ### Member Self-Service Members install nothing: magpie's gateway ships a key page at `/me`. - At `http://:3425/me` a member enters their key and sees that key's name, limits and progress, usage over today / 7 / 30 days, its most-used models, and setup snippets for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible clients. The page is available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and German. - The key is kept in the tab's `sessionStorage` only; no cookie is set, and the page refuses to be framed. Its data endpoint is `GET /v1/magpie/me`; unknown, disabled, or wrong keys get a 401, and `?key=` is refused so a key never lands in an address bar or a log. - This is magpie's own feature, available since 0.1.2226. If members can call the gateway (LAN sharing or a reverse proxy), they can open it. This plugin no longer ships a portal of its own, so there is no second login, session, and usage-scoping implementation to maintain. - If you truly need **per-request detail** (individual calls, failure reasons, key expiry), the plan is to upstream that into magpie's key page rather than build another page here. ### Templates - Save a common combination of models, accounts, limits, expiry, read-only mode, and child-key permission as a template, then apply it to single or batch key creation. Every limit window and cache-read flag is preserved. - Templates can be renamed or deleted, and **Issue keys with this template** jumps to batch creation with the template preselected. - Templates live in `plugin-data/magpie-gateway-admin/templates.json` under the config directory and never touch magpie's own config. Templates store relative window definitions, not a specific key's `since`. - Up to 40 templates can be stored; template names are limited to 60 characters. ## Installation Requires magpie ≥ 0.1.3078 (older versions do not have plugin pages). The plugin targets the Bun runtime and declares Bun ≥ 1.1 in `package.json`; Bun is also needed for development and for running the local service directly. ```bash # From npm magpie plugin add magpie-gateway-admin # From GitHub (no npm needed; uses the build output committed in the repo) magpie plugin add github:guangzan/magpie-gateway-admin # From a local directory magpie plugin add /path/to/magpie-gateway-admin ``` After installation, **Gateway Admin** appears in the sidebar. The first open starts the plugin's local service (default `127.0.0.1:3478`) and navigates the page to it. ### Config Directory The plugin resolves the config directory using magpie's own rules, so it reads and writes the same `caller-keys.json`: 1. `data/` beside the magpie executable (portable install, or a `.portable` marker); shared folders and system-moved Downloads / Desktop / Documents follow magpie's `shared` / `movedFolder` rules; 2. `XDG_CONFIG_HOME/magpie`; 3. `~/.config/magpie` (on Windows, `USERPROFILE`, not `APPDATA`). `MAGPIE_ADMIN_CONFIG_DIR` (or `MAGPIE_CONFIG_DIR`) forces the plugin to use a different config directory, but **magpie itself does not read either variable**. The plugin and magpie will probably be looking at different data; the page shows a warning at the top. Only use this when you know magpie points at the same directory. > [!WARNING] > Do not use a config directory override to "isolate a test environment" unless magpie is pointed at that directory too. Keys and limits written by the plugin may be invisible to magpie. The gateway address comes from `MAGPIE_ADDR`; otherwise the plugin reads `port` from `settings.json`, then falls back to `3425`. ### Port If the default port is occupied, change it in the plugin options: ```bash magpie plugin options magpie-gateway-admin '{"port": 3479}' ``` This service always listens on `127.0.0.1` and is not exposed to the LAN: the plugin page already runs in a loopback sandboxed iframe, and the member entry point is the gateway's own `/me`, so no second public port is needed. Uninstall: ```bash magpie plugin rm magpie-gateway-admin ``` ## How It Works magpie plugin pages run inside an iframe with `sandbox="allow-scripts"` and a `connect-src 'none'` CSP. The iframe has an opaque origin: the page cannot make requests, has no cookies or localStorage, and cannot reach `/api`. So the page does exactly one thing—it navigates to a local HTTP service started by the plugin host (`magpie.page.service` in `package.json`). The real UI and API live on that service: ```text magpie window └── iframe (sandbox=allow-scripts, can only load its own files) └── location.replace → http://127.0.0.1:3478/ ├── ui/ admin UI ├── lib/server.mjs local API ├── magpie gateway-key … issue / rotate / remove keys, set accounts, reset usage ├── /caller-keys.json limits, models, accounts, expiry └── gateway (settings.json port, default 127.0.0.1:3425) limits, usage, requests, model catalog Members do not go through this service: they open the gateway's own http:///me. ``` The plugin reads gateway endpoints (`/v1/magpie/limit`, `/v1/magpie/usage`, `/v1/magpie/usage/requests`, `/v1/models`, `/v1/magpie/quotas`) and writes `caller-keys.json`. It uses the same `caller-keys.json.lock` as magpie (`flock`; Windows falls back to the plugin's own lock file), performs atomic writes via temporary file + rename, keeps permissions at `0600`, and takes a backup before each write. ## Security - **Loopback only**: the admin service always binds `127.0.0.1`. Requests must use a `Host` of `127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, or `[::1]`—anything else gets a 421, which also blocks DNS rebinding. The admin API additionally checks the connection's source address and accepts loopback only—another machine cannot get in even by forging `Host: 127.0.0.1`. - **Per-start token**: each start generates a random token, inlines it into the HTML, and requires it in `x-magpie-admin-token` (compared with `timingSafeEqual`). Other web pages cannot obtain the token and therefore cannot call the API. - **Origin checks**: non-local `Origin` values get a 403. CORS reflects only a local origin and never uses a wildcard; `Origin: null` is accepted only for magpie's own sandboxed page. - **Strict CSP**: the admin page uses `default-src 'none'`, `script-src 'nonce-…'`, and `connect-src 'self'`, with explicit allowances for `http://127.0.0.1:` / `localhost` / `[::1]`. It cannot send `X-Frame-Options` / `frame-ancestors 'none'`: it intentionally runs inside magpie's sandbox iframe, and framing protection would break the entire plugin. Cross-site protection comes from Host and Origin checks plus the per-start token. For the same reason the server does not send `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin`; an opaque-origin iframe would be blocked from loading its own assets. - **Member-side security is magpie's**: the `/me` login, session, and data scoping are the gateway's own implementation (`keypage.html` and `GET /v1/magpie/me`). This plugin never touches a member's key or session. - **Secrets on demand**: list responses contain only masked keys (last 4–6 characters). Clicking **Copy** fetches the plaintext once from the local service, and only a page holding the admin token can do that. Rotation shows the new secret once more. - **File permissions**: exported CSVs and backups are `0600`, matching `caller-keys.json`. Delivery CSVs contain plaintext keys—delete them after distribution; they do not expire automatically. ## Sandbox Limitations These are not bugs; they are consequences of magpie's iframe policy. The plugin provides a workaround for each: | Capability | Result in the sandbox | Workaround | | --- | --- | --- | | `
` submission | No `allow-forms`; `submit` does not fire | All actions use buttons; Enter is handled manually in inputs | | `confirm()` | No `allow-modals`; returns `false` | Custom confirmation dialogs | | `navigator.clipboard` / `execCommand('copy')` | Rejected (`NotAllowedError`) | Show the content selected in a dialog and prompt for ⌘C | | `a[download]` | No `allow-downloads`; fails silently | The host service writes the file to disk and the UI shows the path | | `localStorage` | Opaque origin; `SecurityError` | Preferences such as the usage period are not persisted | ## Known Limitations - `magpie.page.service` is not yet in the public docs (the community plugin `@magpie-community/page-chat` uses it too). If magpie changes this field, the page falls back to a static explanation page. - The default shared key (LAN key) cannot be renamed, disabled, re-expired, made read-only, deleted, or rotated here—it belongs to magpie's own Gateway page. Changing its expiry would effectively disable it, so that is blocked too. The plugin rejects these actions explicitly and disables the corresponding row actions. - If another admin instance occupies the port, the plugin only reuses it when both the config directory and version match. Otherwise it refuses to start and prints a command for changing the port, so the page cannot silently manage a different `caller-keys.json`. - Account binding goes through `magpie gateway-key accounts`, and magpie validates the provider. magpie 0.1.3078's `gateway-key` has no `mcp` subcommand, so the plugin does not offer per-key MCP binding. - The plugin assumes magpie and the admin service run on the same machine: the server reads usage, limits, and the model catalog as loopback. If `MAGPIE_ADDR` points at a remote gateway, that side rejects unauthenticated requests and the lists show no usage or limits. - The member entry point relies on magpie's built-in `/me` (0.1.2226+). If you need per-request detail, upstream it into magpie's key page rather than adding another portal here. - Exports are written on the machine running magpie. The sandbox page cannot download files directly; this is a deliberate tradeoff. ## Development ```bash pnpm install # React / Ant Design / zustand / vite / typescript pnpm build # tsc check + vite build into ui/dist (build output is committed, no build needed on install) pnpm dev:ui # vite dev server, /api proxied to 127.0.0.1:3478 bun test # 62 tests: paths, validation, file I/O, HTTP API, batch operations, static page, security headers bun run serve # run the service without magpie, then open http://127.0.0.1:3478/ ``` Tests use a fake `magpie` CLI and a temporary config directory, so they never touch real keys. `ui/dist` is committed: magpie does not run build scripts when installing from git or npm, so rebuild with `pnpm build` and commit the output after changing the UI. ### Environment Variables | Variable | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `MAGPIE_ADMIN_CONFIG_DIR` / `MAGPIE_CONFIG_DIR` | Force the plugin to use another config directory. **magpie does not read either variable**; only use this when magpie points there too. | | `MAGPIE_ADDR` | Gateway address, such as `127.0.0.1:3425` or `http://127.0.0.1:3425`; `http://` is added when the scheme is omitted. | | `MAGPIE_BIN` | Path to the magpie CLI; otherwise the plugin searches `PATH` and common install locations. | | `MAGPIE_ADMIN_ORIGINS` | Extra allowed browser origins, comma-separated; development only. | | `PORT` | Port for `bun run serve`, default `3478`. | ### Stack and Layout The UI uses React 19, Ant Design 6, and TypeScript, with zustand for state and vite for bundling. It follows magpie's own theme setting (light, dark, or system), not just macOS's appearance: the navigation carries the current mode in the URL hash, and the page then keeps receiving theme changes and `--magpie-*` color tokens through magpie's page bridge. Opened directly in a browser, it falls back to the system `prefers-color-scheme`. It also disables all Ant Design motion (`wave` and `token.motion`) because the page runs inside magpie's sandbox iframe—animation only makes people wait. ```text index.mjs plugin host entry (starts the service on import) page/ the page loaded inside magpie; it only navigates ui/src/ admin UI source (App / views / modals / store / api / types) ui/dist/ vite build output, served directly ui/vite.config.ts base "./", target safari17, dev proxy lib/server.mjs local HTTP API (Origin/Host checks, batch transaction rollback) lib/store.mjs caller-keys.json read/write and locking lib/cli.mjs magpie gateway-key wrapper lib/gateway.mjs gateway read-only API (short TTL cache) lib/validate.mjs validation aligned with magpie's access package lib/templates.mjs templates lib/csv.mjs CSV generation (formula injection escaping) lib/errors.mjs standard HTTP errors lib/lock.mjs cross-process flock lib/paths.mjs magpie config directory, gateway address, CLI path ``` ### Releasing Pushing a `v*` tag runs `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: tests and build first, then `npm publish` through npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC). No `NPM_TOKEN` is stored in the repository. Bump `package.json` before tagging; the tag must match the version. --- ## License [Apache-2.0](./LICENSE). 简体中文 · English

magpie 网关用户管理

给 magpie 的网关加上多用户管理：批量发 key、限额、模型权限、用量看板。成员自己查用量走 magpie 网关自带的 /me 页，不需要额外部署。

简体中文 · English

magpie 自带的 Gateway 页面是给单用户准备的：一把共享 key，改不了名、停不了用。这个插件补的是「把网关开给一群人」的那部分——每把 key 有自己的权限、限额和用量。 > [!NOTE] > 插件不替换 magpie 的 Gateway 页面。默认共享 key 仍然由 magpie 自己管理；这里管理的是新建的多用户 key。 ## 快速开始 1. 安装插件： ```bash # 本地目录 magpie plugin add /path/to/magpie-gateway-admin # 或者 GitHub magpie plugin add github:guangzan/magpie-gateway-admin ``` 2. 打开侧边栏里的「网关用户管理」。 3. 点「批量发 key」，设置名称前缀、有效期和权限；创建后复制或导出明文。 4. 要让用户自己查用量，把**网关的 `/me` 页**发给他们：`http://<运行 magpie 的机器>:3425/me`（端口以 magpie 的设置为准）。他们输入自己的 key 就能看到额度、用量和客户端配置，见下面的「成员自助查用量」。这个地址在 magpie 的 Gateway → Gateway keys 里可以一键复制。 第一次打开会启动插件自己的本地服务，默认地址是 `http://127.0.0.1:3478/`（只在本机，给管理员用）。 ## 能做什么 ### 用户与密钥 - **批量发 key**：一次发 1–100 把，名称按前缀自动编号（`team-a-01`、`team-a-02`…）。整批是一个事务：任何一把失败，这一批已经落盘的 key 全部删掉，不留半批没限额的孤儿。 - **权限配置**：新建页把模型白名单（`openai/*`、`anthropic/claude-*`、`group/<路由组>`、`group/*`）、上游账号、限额、只读、是否允许查看上游账号余额、是否允许签发子 key 收在一起。 - **限额**：支持每天 / 每周 / 每月 / N 天 / N 小时，最多五条，可按 tokens 或美元计，也可把缓存读计入 tokens；tokens 和美元都填 0 表示这条不限。默认每月 $20 一条，可改可删。 - **限额的作用范围**：magpie 的限额目前不能按模型拆分（`access.Limit` 没有这个字段），所以这里也不提供「只算某些模型」的假开关；限额作用于这把 key 的全部调用。 - **到期与窗口**：单把新建可以直接选到期日；批量按「有效期（天）」算。编辑已有 key 时窗口起点（`since`）和缓存读开关会原样保留，改限额不会把周期窗口清空重发。 - **交付密钥**：创建成功后直接打开交付弹窗，明文可以逐把复制、复制全部或导出 CSV。列表本身只显示掩码；轮换后会再弹一次新明文。 - **限额状态**：列表显示每把 key 当前最紧的一条限额：已用 / 上限 / 重置时间，跑满标红；详情页可以清零已用量（日历窗口的结束时间不变）。 - **用量列**：列表能看到每把 key 今天 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天的调用数和花费；花费按网关价格估算，未计价的调用会标 `*` 并写明次数。 - **需要关注**：出现限额用尽、接近上限（≥80%）、7 天内到期时，列表顶部会给出提示，点一下就筛选到对应 key；还可以按状态筛选、按名称 / 调用 / 花费 / 限额使用率排序。 - **批量操作**：列表支持多选，批量启用 / 停用 / 删除；停用和删除的确认框会列出受影响的 key 名称。 - **搜索与分页**：按名称 / id / 掩码搜索，本地分页；key 多的时候不用滚到底。 - **导出 CSV**：含用量，由服务端生成，文件写在配置目录下的 `plugin-data/magpie-gateway-admin/exports/`，文件名带时间戳，不会互相覆盖。用量取不到时导出会失败，不会生成一份「调用 0 / 花费 0」的假报表；已经删除的 key 只要有调用，也会以「已删除」一行保留在导出里，不会让这部分花费对不上账。 ### 用量 - 按区间汇总：总调用、错误、tokens、缓存读写、花费（估算）、未计价调用。 - 按 key 分组，可点列头按调用 / 错误 / 输入 / 输出 / 缓存读 / 花费排序；点分组里的任意一行，下面的「最近请求」就只看这把 key，可用标签上的 × 取消。 - 单个请求能看到时间、模型、状态、耗时、输入输出和花费，支持失败 / 重试过滤和搜索。 - 网关连不上或接口报错时显示持久错误提示和「重试」，不会把失败显示成 0 和空表；切换区间会先清掉旧数字，避免两个区间混在一起。 > [!NOTE] > 花费按网关价格估算；未计价调用按 $0 计，不计入美元限额。统计区间以运行网关的机器时区为准。 ### 成员自助查用量 成员不需要装任何东西：magpie 网关自带 key 页面，打开网关地址下的 `/me` 就行。 - 用户在 `http://<运行 magpie 的机器>:3425/me` 输入自己的 key，看到的是这把 key 自己的名称、限额和进度、今日 / 7 天 / 30 天用量、最常用的模型，以及 Claude Code、Codex、OpenAI 兼容客户端的配置片段。页面支持简体中文、繁体中文、日语和德语。 - key 只放在标签页的 `sessionStorage` 里，不下发 cookie，页面不接受被别的网页嵌入；数据接口是 `GET /v1/magpie/me`，未知、停用或写错的 key 一律 401，`?key=` 直接被拒（key 不会进地址栏或日志）。 - 这是 magpie 自己的功能，从 0.1.2226 起就有；只要成员能调用网关（局域网共享或反向代理），就一定能打开它。这个插件不再单独提供用户端页面，避免维护第二套登录、会话和用量裁剪逻辑。 - 如果确实需要**请求级明细**（逐条调用、失败原因、key 到期时间），现在的做法是把这部分上游到 magpie 的 key 页面，而不是在插件里再做一个页面。 ### 模板 - 把常用的「模型 + 账号 + 限额 + 有效期 + 只读 + 子 key 签发」存成模板，单个或批量发 key 时选一下就行；所有限额窗口和缓存读开关都会原样带过去。 - 模板页可以改名、删除，也可以直接点「用此模板发 key」跳到批量发 key 并预选这个模板。 - 模板存在配置目录下的 `plugin-data/magpie-gateway-admin/templates.json`，不碰 magpie 自己的配置。模板只保存相对的窗口定义，不保存某一把 key 的 `since`。 - 最多保存 40 个模板；模板名称最长 60 个字符。 ## 安装 需要 magpie ≥ 0.1.3078（更早的版本没有插件页面）。插件按 Bun 运行时编写，`package.json` 要求 Bun ≥ 1.1；开发和直接运行本地服务时也需要 Bun。 ```bash # npm magpie plugin add magpie-gateway-admin # GitHub（不用 npm，直接读仓库里提交的构建产物） magpie plugin add github:guangzan/magpie-gateway-admin # 本地目录 magpie plugin add /path/to/magpie-gateway-admin ``` 装好之后侧边栏会多出「网关用户管理」。第一次打开会启动插件自己的本地服务（默认 `127.0.0.1:3478`），页面跳到它上面跑。 ### 配置目录 配置目录默认按 magpie 自己的规则解析，不会出现「插件读写另一份 `caller-keys.json`」： 1. magpie 可执行文件旁的 `data/`（portable 安装，或有 `.portable` 标记）；共享目录和系统搬走的下载 / 桌面 / 文档目录按 magpie 的 `shared` / `movedFolder` 规则判断； 2. `XDG_CONFIG_HOME/magpie`； 3. `~/.config/magpie`（Windows 用 `USERPROFILE`，不是 `APPDATA`）。 `MAGPIE_ADMIN_CONFIG_DIR`（或 `MAGPIE_CONFIG_DIR`）可以让插件强制换一份配置目录，但 **magpie 本身不读这两个变量**。设了以后插件和 magpie 很可能不是同一份数据，页面顶部会显示警告——只在明确知道 magpie 也指向那里时使用。 > [!WARNING] > 不要用配置目录覆盖来「隔离测试环境」，除非你也把 magpie 指到同一目录。插件写进去的 key 和限额，magpie 可能根本看不到。 网关地址优先读 `MAGPIE_ADDR`，否则读 `settings.json` 里的 `port`，最后才回落到默认的 `3425`。 ### 端口 管理服务的端口被占用时可以在插件选项里改： ```bash magpie plugin options magpie-gateway-admin '{"port": 3479}' ``` 这个服务只监听 `127.0.0.1`，不给局域网开放：插件页面本来就在本机的沙箱 iframe 里，而成员入口是 magpie 网关自己的 `/me`，不需要第二个对外端口。 卸载： ```bash magpie plugin rm magpie-gateway-admin ``` ## 它是怎么工作的 magpie 的插件页面跑在 `sandbox="allow-scripts"` 的 iframe 里，CSP 是 `connect-src 'none'`，源是不透明的：页面发不出请求，也没有 cookie 和 localStorage，更拿不到 `/api`。 所以页面只做一件事——把自己导航到插件宿主起的本地 HTTP 服务（`package.json` 里的 `magpie.page.service`）。真正的界面和接口都在那个服务上： ```text magpie 窗口 └── iframe（sandbox=allow-scripts，只能加载自己的文件） └── location.replace → http://127.0.0.1:3478/ ├── ui/ 管理界面 ├── lib/server.mjs 本地接口 ├── magpie gateway-key … 发 key / 轮换 / 删 key / 改账号 / 清零已用量 ├── <配置目录>/caller-keys.json 限额、模型、账号、到期 └── 网关（settings.json 的 port，默认 127.0.0.1:3425） 限额余量、用量、请求明细、模型目录 成员侧不经过这个服务：他们打开的是网关自己的 http://<网关地址>/me。 ``` 插件读取网关的只读接口（`/v1/magpie/limit`、`/v1/magpie/usage`、`/v1/magpie/usage/requests`、`/v1/models`、`/v1/magpie/quotas`），写入 `caller-keys.json`。写入和 magpie 用同一个 `caller-keys.json.lock`（`flock`；Windows 退化成插件自己的锁文件），采用「临时文件 + rename」原子写，权限 `0600`，改之前留一份备份。 ## 安全 - **只监听本机**：管理服务固定绑定 `127.0.0.1`，不对外网开放；请求的 `Host` 必须是 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]`，否则直接 421，防止 DNS rebinding。管理接口还会检查连接来源的 IP，只接受回环地址——别的机器即使伪造 `Host: 127.0.0.1` 也进不来。 - **每次启动换 token**：服务启动时生成随机 token，内联进 HTML，接口用 `x-magpie-admin-token` 校验（`timingSafeEqual`）。别的网页拿不到这个 token，也就调不动接口。 - **同源检查**：非本机 `Origin` 一律 403；CORS 只把请求里的本机 `Origin` 原样还回去，不做通配反射；`Origin: null` 只留给 magpie 自己的沙箱页面。 - **严格 CSP**：管理页使用 `default-src 'none'`、`script-src 'nonce-…'`、`connect-src 'self'`，并显式放行 `http://127.0.0.1:` / `localhost` / `[::1]` 这几个本机源。这里不能加 `X-Frame-Options` / `frame-ancestors 'none'`：这一页本来就跑在 magpie 的 sandbox iframe 里，禁框会把整个插件挡在外面；防跨站靠 Host、Origin 校验和每次启动的 token。同理也不发 `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin`，否则 opaque 源的 iframe 加载不了自己的构建产物。 - **成员侧的安全由 magpie 负责**：`/me` 的登录、会话、数据裁剪都是网关自己的实现（`keypage.html` + `GET /v1/magpie/me`），这个插件不接触成员的 key 和会话。 - **明文按需取**：列表接口只给掩码（末 4–6 位）；点「复制」时向本地服务单独取一次明文，只有拿着页面 token 的管理页调得动。轮换后会弹一次新明文。 - **文件权限**：导出的 CSV 和备份都是 `0600`，和 `caller-keys.json` 同目录权限。交付用的密钥 CSV 是明文，分发完请手动删除——它不会自动过期。 ## 沙箱里做不了的几件事 这几个不是 bug，是 magpie 的 iframe 策略决定的，插件里都做了替代方案： | 能力 | 沙箱里的结果 | 这里的做法 | | --- | --- | --- | | `
` 提交 | 没有 `allow-forms`，`submit` 事件不触发 | 全部用按钮点击，回车在输入框里手动接管 | | `confirm()` | 没有 `allow-modals`，直接返回 `false` | 自己画确认弹窗 | | `navigator.clipboard` / `execCommand('copy')` | 被拒（`NotAllowedError`） | 弹窗里把内容全选，提示按 ⌘C | | `a[download]` | 没有 `allow-downloads`，静默失败 | 让宿主服务把文件写到磁盘，界面给出路径 | | `localStorage` | 不透明源，`SecurityError` | 用量区间这类偏好不持久化 | ## 已知限制 - `magpie.page.service` 目前没有写进公开文档（社区插件 `@magpie-community/page-chat` 用的也是它）。magpie 改了这个字段的话，页面会退化成一张静态说明页。 - 默认的共享 key（LAN key）不能在插件里改名、停用、改到期、设只读、删除或轮换——那是 magpie 自己 Gateway 页面管的。改到期同样能让 key 失效，所以和「停用」一样被拦住。插件里会明确拒绝并提示，列表里对应的操作也会禁用。 - 端口被另一个管理台占着时，只有在配置目录和版本都一致时才复用；不一致会拒绝启动并给换端口的命令，避免页面管到另一份 `caller-keys.json`。 - 账号绑定走 `magpie gateway-key accounts`，由 magpie 自己校验 provider 是否存在。magpie 0.1.3078 的 `gateway-key` 没有 `mcp` 子命令，所以插件不提供 per-key 的 MCP 绑定。 - 插件假定 magpie 网关和管理服务跑在同一台机器上：服务端以 loopback 身份读取用量、限额和模型目录。`MAGPIE_ADDR` 指向远端网关时，远端会把无 key 的请求拒掉，列表里的用量和限额会取不到。 - 成员自助入口依赖 magpie 自带的 `/me`（0.1.2226+）。需要请求级明细时，请上游到 magpie 的 key 页面，而不是在这里再加一个用户端。 - 导出落在运行 magpie 的那台机器上。沙箱页面不能直接下载，这是取舍。 ## 开发 ```bash pnpm install # React / Ant Design / zustand / vite / typescript pnpm build # tsc 检查 + vite 打包到 ui/dist（提交了构建产物，装插件时不用再 build） pnpm dev:ui # vite dev server，/api 代理到 127.0.0.1:3478 bun test # 62 个测试：路径解析、校验、文件读写、HTTP 接口、批量操作、静态页、安全头 bun run serve # 不起 magpie，直接跑服务，浏览器开 http://127.0.0.1:3478/ ``` 测试用假的 `magpie` CLI 和一个临时配置目录，不会碰你真实的 key。 `ui/dist` 是提交进仓库的构建产物：magpie 从 git 或 npm 安装插件时不会执行构建脚本，改完界面要重新 `pnpm build` 并一起提交。 ### 环境变量 | 变量 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `MAGPIE_ADMIN_CONFIG_DIR` / `MAGPIE_CONFIG_DIR` | 强制插件使用另一份配置目录。**magpie 不读这两个变量**，只在明确知道 magpie 也指向那里时使用。 | | `MAGPIE_ADDR` | 网关地址，例如 `127.0.0.1:3425`、`http://127.0.0.1:3425`；省略协议时自动补 `http://`。 | | `MAGPIE_BIN` | magpie CLI 的路径；不设时从 `PATH` 和常见安装位置查找。 | | `MAGPIE_ADMIN_ORIGINS` | 额外允许的浏览器来源，逗号分隔；只用于开发调试。 | | `PORT` | `bun run serve` 的端口，默认 `3478`。 | ### 技术栈和目录 界面是 React 19 + Ant Design 6 + TypeScript，状态用 zustand，打包用 vite。主题跟随 magpie 自己的设置（浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统），而不是只看 macOS 的外观：跳转时用 URL hash 带上当前深浅，之后通过 magpie 的 page bridge 继续接收主题切换和 `--magpie-*` 颜色 token；在浏览器里单独打开时回落到系统的 `prefers-color-scheme`。同时关掉了 Ant Design 的所有动效（`wave` 和 `token.motion`），因为插件页在 magpie 的沙箱 iframe 里，动画只会让人等。 ```text index.mjs 插件宿主入口（import 时起服务） page/ 在 magpie 里跑的那一页，只负责跳转 ui/src/ 管理界面源码（App / views / modals / store / api / types） ui/dist/ vite 构建产物，服务直接托管 ui/vite.config.ts base "./"、target safari17、dev 代理 lib/server.mjs 本地 HTTP 接口（含 Origin/Host 校验、批量事务回滚） lib/store.mjs caller-keys.json 的读写与加锁 lib/cli.mjs magpie gateway-key 的封装 lib/gateway.mjs 网关只读接口（带短 TTL 缓存） lib/validate.mjs 与 magpie access 包对齐的校验 lib/templates.mjs 模板 lib/csv.mjs CSV 生成（公式注入转义） lib/errors.mjs 标准 HTTP 错误 lib/lock.mjs 跨进程 flock lib/paths.mjs magpie 配置目录、网关地址、CLI 路径 ``` ### 发布 推 `v*` tag 会触发 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`：先跑测试和构建，再通过 npm 的 Trusted Publishing（OIDC）发布，不需要在仓库里存 `NPM_TOKEN`。发布前记得把 `package.json` 的版本号改好，tag 必须和它一致。 --- ##
